openingMessage: The most important thing in the world is family and love. Never forget that.
openingWhy: Every rule we run — the attendant who stays put, the tested atmosphere, the staged rescue — traces back to some kitchen table that got a phone call instead of a truck in the driveway. The standard was never for the client. It's for whoever is waiting on you tonight.
leadershipThought: Act like a professional at all times. Respect the environment. Be aware. Don't create distractions. Act like the person the client would want back tomorrow.

fieldNews.headline: Ralph Forbes — clean trailer inspection at 5:03 AM, before the drive
fieldNews.detail: Wednesday, trailer 139: complete and clean before the Highway 176 crash. Doing it right can't stop a reckless driver, but it's why we never stop doing it right.

fieldNews.headline: Justin Pack — six days running with nothing to fix
fieldNews.detail: Hughes #1, Friday through Wednesday: complete daily each day, both cascade fields, every photo from that morning.

fieldNews.headline: Andrew Bailey — trailer 602 covered three days running
fieldNews.detail: Wednesday: three trailer inspections and two air jobs, complete throughout.

fieldNews.headline: Marcos Morales — clean H2S daily at St Elmo, supervision job closed out
fieldNews.detail: Wednesday: nothing for the review to flag, and the multi-day supervision job closed properly.

fieldNews.headline: Joseph Popillion — held the job and used stop work over a leaking casing
fieldNews.detail: Shull Crawford 15OO 115H, Monday: gas showed when the valves opened. Hold point, a plan, the right people notified, and the disconnect stopped until the crew was comfortable.

fieldNews.headline: Michael Jobe — no tag, no cones: found it and fixed it before work began
fieldNews.detail: Brook N-13EN 214H, Monday: told the person in charge and had it corrected before the job started. Find it, fix it, write it.

fieldNews.headline: Highway 176 fog crash, Wednesday morning: five miles from the shop
fieldNews.detail: A driver weaving between semis tried to pass in fog and dark. Ralph and Jimmy are both okay and home with family. Slow down to what you can see, back off the semis, and let the weaver go.

todaysChallenge: Your standard today protects people you'll never meet — the night crew, the pumper tomorrow, somebody's dad next month. Leave the location better because you were on it.
todaysChallengeSubtext: “A life is not important except in the impact it has on other lives.” — Jackie Robinson
